systems.tiers: a central electronic register; section 6(6) requires the Registrar to give online access to it to the Malawi Investment and Trade Centre, the Malawi Revenue Authority, the National Statistical Office and any local authority

note: A statute (commenced 27 May 2013): it obliges the Registrar to give any local authority online access to the business register, which is a legal duty and not a statement that any council office is connected or uses it.
